Electropuls E3000 All-Electric Dynamic Test Instrument
Product catalog summary
Overview: The ElectroPuls™ E3000 is an advanced all-electric test instrument designed for both dynamic and static testing across various materials and components. It features state-of-the-art digital control electronics, a Dynacell™ load cell, and Console software, offering a hassle-free tuning system based on specimen stiffness. The system is powered by a single-phase supply, eliminating the need for additional utilities like pneumatic air or hydraulics.
Key Features:
Patented oil-free linear motor technology for clean operation.
Dynamic performance capable of operating over 100 Hz.
Dynamic load capacity of ±3000 N and static load capacity of ±2100 N.
Temperature-controlled air-cooling system.
High-stiffness, precision-aligned twin column load frame.
Compact design requiring less than 0.3 m² of space.
Hardware and Software:
Console software interface for enhanced usability.
Control pod with critical controls and emergency stop.
Electrically powered crosshead lift system with manual lever clamps.
System Status Indicator for operational conditions.
Technology and Versatility:
Stiffness-based loop tuning system for improved testing.
Unique actuator bearing system for load alignment.
Optical encoder for precise digital extension control.
Compatible with various software and accessories like grips, fixtures, and chambers.
Specifications:
Dynamic Capacity: ±3000 N (±675 lbf).
Static Capacity: ±2100 N (±472 lbf).
Stroke: 60 mm (2.36 in).
Load Weighing Accuracy: ±0.5% of indicated load or ±0.005% of load cell capacity.
Daylight Opening: 855 mm (33.6 in) maximum.
Configuration: Twin-column with actuator in upper crosshead.
Weight: 200 kg (441 lb) for frame, 38 kg (84 lb) for controller.
Electrical Supply: 208 VAC to 240 VAC 16A single phase 50/60 Hz.
Operating Temperature: +10 to +30°C (+50 to +86°F).
Interfaces and Accessories:
Actuator and T-Slot Table with various thread and hole configurations.
High stiffness table and safety screen available.
Fatigue-rated mechanical and pneumatic wedge grips.
Pneumatic grip air kit for dynamic systems.
Hardware operator panel for additional control.
